item.title: Small Space Organization: Transforming a 3‑ft Wide Hallway into Functional Coat and Shoe Storage
item.description: A three-foot-wide hallway can feel impossible to organize because the passage is already doing an important job: moving people from one room to another. The solution is not to fill the corridor with storage. It is to use the wall carefully, keep bulky items out of the traffic path, and make the everyday entry routine easier. This guide uses a measurement-first approach. You will assess the hallway, choose a storage depth, divide coats and shoes into practical zones, install or position the storage, test the walking route, and create a maintenance routine that takes only a few minutes.
